newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary BCE mulls Czech crown, gold futures launch.
newsitem.headline: Hungary BCE mulls Czech crown, gold futures launch.

text.p: The Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) is considering introducing futures trading for Czech crown and gold, the BCE's head said on Wednesday.
"We are seriously considering these plans, and concrete steps are possible in the near future," Szergej Keresztesi, president of the BCE council told Reuters.

The financial section of the BCE trades mark, yen, sterling, Swiss franc, dollar, Ecu and Italian lira futures, as well as one- and three-month BUBOR (Budapest Interbank Offered Rate) futures and three-month interest rates.
The BCE also trades traditional commodities in its grains and livehog sections.
